jobs.description:
The Amazon Search Navigation AI team helps customers go from a broad search intent to the few products that fit their needs, so they can make a confident purchase decision. We generate highly relevant, context-aware, and personalized search refinements. We also decide the order they appear in across Amazon's Search Navigation experiences, guiding customers to the most relevant results. The team owns Search Navigation's P0 metrics and defect guardrails, which keep performance and reliability high for hundreds of millions of customers.

We are reinventing search refinement with generative AI. Our recently launched Smart Refinement experience uses large language models (LLMs) served online to turn product specifications into natural-language suggestions that match how customers think, such as "for colder weather" or "lightweight for travel." Each suggestion is personalized to the customer's context. Next, we are building multi-turn, conversational refinement, where each interaction builds on the last and helps customers narrow their intent in fewer steps.

We build and run the engineering systems behind this work, including the Navigation Experience Service (NES). NES connects to Amazon's core search systems, serves more than 3 billion queries worldwide every day, and runs real-time LLM inference at global scale under strict latency and cost limits. Our platform supports launches of new navigation content and UIs, and it makes fast offline and online experimentation possible.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to be a technical leader on the team. You will shape the architecture of our Search Navigation platform, including the systems that serve LLMs in real time, lead complex projects that span multiple teams, and work closely with Applied Scientists to take LLM innovations from research into production. You are comfortable with ambiguity, you set a high bar for engineering, and you are curious about applied science.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of large-scale, distributed, low-latency services that power Amazon Search Navigation experiences worldwide
- Own the technical direction for online LLM serving in Search Navigation, including GPU and accelerator inference, request-time personalization, asynchronous rendering, caching, and cost and latency optimization
- Drive the engineering roadmap for Smart Refinement and multi-turn conversational refinement, scaling from initial launch to a much larger share of search traffic
- Build safe, reliable GenAI experiences with layered safeguards: input triggering and exclusion controls, output validation and filtering, and graceful fallbacks
- Partner with Applied Scientists, Product Managers, and Program Managers to define requirements and bring models (including distilled LLMs) into production
- Design and build scalable data pipelines that process petabytes of search and behavioral data for feature generation, model training, distillation, and evaluation
- Drive experimentation strategy: design, run, and analyze online A/B experiments, and make data-driven launch recommendations
- Own operational excellence for critical services, including P0 metrics, defect guardrails, monitoring, on-call health, and availability and latency goals
- Lead cross-team initiatives, influence the technical decisions of partner teams across Search, and mentor engineers while raising the engineering bar

jobs.description:
If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/

About Us:

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to solve challenging and open-ended problems in the domain of Creators and content contextual signals. As an Applied Scientist on Twitch's GTM Science team, you will use applied machine learning to tackle ambiguous business problems across problem areas such as Ads, Brand Safety, Creator Sponsorship and Content Understanding. You will lead high profile projects where you will use a wide toolbox of ML tools to handle multiple types of data, including user behavior, metadata, and user generated content such as text and video. You will collaborate with a team of passionate scientists, engineers, and product stakeholders to develop these models, prototype and put them into production, where they can help Twitch's creators and viewers succeed and build communities.

You will report to our Senior Data Science Manager for GTM. This position is located in San Francisco, CA.

You Will

- Build machine learning products to enrich Twitch’s content understanding and help creators and viewers build and discover their communities.
- Propose, design, and oversee execution for high-impact projects that work backwards from customer problems to develop the right solution for the job. Know when to use a classical ML model versus a state-of-the-art one.
- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering and product teams to prototype and deploy your models into flexible data pipelines and ML-based services.
- Bring innovation and help drive science culture on the team by staying up to date and experimenting with new techniques in LLM, computer vision, inference and model evaluation.

Perks
* Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
* 401(k)
* Maternity & Parental Leave
* Flexible PTO
* Amazon Employee Discount

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to organize, drive, and deliver Amazon-wide programs spanning multiple departments with visibility at the VP+ level. You should be passionate about Alexa+ – Amazon's most ambitious AI assistant – and energized by driving cross-department, cross-functional programs across distributed systems, LLMs, and critical infrastructure. This role requires perseverance, strong technical acumen, and exceptional collaboration skills to lead complex initiatives at scale across thousands of engineers.

Key job responsibilities
You will be responsible for setting up, driving, championing, and successfully delivering large initiatives spanning Alexa, AWS, and AGI – across both device and cloud domains. You will:

- Work directly with VP and key Alexa executives
- Drive the program strategy for large-scale, cross-organizational initiatives spanning Alexa, AWS, and AGI
- Own end-to-end delivery of programs that directly impact Alexa+'s core experience across distributed systems, LLMs, and critical infrastructure
- Establish program frameworks, governance models, and operating mechanisms that scale across thousands of engineers in multiple organizations
- Identify and resolve systemic cross-organizational dependencies, driving alignment across VP-level leadership when priorities conflict
- Define success metrics and accountability mechanisms focused on availability, latency, accuracy, cost-effectiveness, and operational excellence
- Influence technical architecture decisions to ensure programs are set up for long-term scalability and maintainability
- Communicate program status, risks, and strategic trade-offs to VP+ leadership; shape narratives for L10+ reviews
- Build and maintain program roadmaps that connect tactical execution to long-term organizational strategy
- Partner with engineering, science, and QA leadership to ensure technical solutions meet quality and performance bars at scale

A day in the life
You operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, spending your day navigating across organizational boundaries to drive Alexa+'s most critical programs forward. You bring the technical curiosity and learning agility to ramp up on any domain – LLMs, distributed systems, device firmware, cloud infrastructure – deeply enough to arbitrate technical disagreements and unblock teams when they can't resolve it themselves.

Strategic Leadership & VP Partnership

- Start the day syncing with your VP on program priorities, escalations, and strategic trade-offs – you are their trusted partner in navigating cross-org complexity
- Shape the agenda for L10+ leadership reviews, framing technical programs in terms of customer impact and business outcomes
- Make judgment calls on where to invest your time: which escalations to own personally, which to delegate, and which to let teams resolve independently
Cross-Organizational Influence

- Drive alignment across Directors and VPs in Alexa, AWS, and AGI when organizations have competing priorities or conflicting technical approaches
- Facilitate high-stakes technical and strategic discussions – not just driving consensus, but making recommendations and influencing decisions
- Operate as the connective tissue between device, cloud, and AI/ML organizations – translating constraints and priorities across domains
Technical Depth & Execution

- Learn technical domains quickly and deeply enough to arbitrate disagreements between engineering teams and unblock stalled decisions
- Deep-dive into technical designs, architecture reviews, and engineering plans – understanding trade-offs well enough to broker the right path forward
- Identify systemic risks and dependencies that no single team can see, then drive mitigation strategies across organizations
- Review program metrics (availability, latency, quality) and take action when trajectories diverge from targets
Driving Outcomes at Scale

- Unblock programs that are stuck – whether the issue is technical, organizational, or political
- Hold teams accountable to commitments while maintaining the relationships that make cross-org collaboration work
- Continuously refine operating mechanisms – knowing when a process is helping and when it's become overhead
